calculation.description: Ranks assets by the negative of their trailing 20-session return divided by trailing 40-session realized daily volatility. The one-session lag ensures only completed data are used. Higher values indicate risk-scaled mean-reversion candidates.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC is positive after reversing the tested volatility-scaled trend direction. Chronological thirds of the original trend IC were -0.065019, -0.019430, and -0.085035, implying reversal remains positive in all three regimes. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation.
